e.title_en: A German insurance and finance comparison portal that ships an unusual test: it loads every detail page in a headless browser and asserts that exactly one calculator is visible. It describes itself in writing as a German comparison portal for insurance and finance products across motor, liability, household contents, private health, occupational disability, and mortgage financing; it is organised as twenty-seven detail pages across five category route groups; each line calculator is a live partner widget with a guard against duplicate injection; and it carries a script that verifies the single-visible-calculator property on every page, while the repository has no licence file.

e.summary_en: This is a German insurance and finance comparison portal, describing itself in writing as a German comparison portal for insurance and financial products covering motor, liability, household contents, private health, occupational disability, and mortgage financing. **Measured this round**: created in late August and last pushed on the ninth of September, a repository of about eight megabytes in TypeScript, no stars, no licence file, and a default branch named master, with a description of about seventeen hundred bytes over forty-five lines. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review.** **Four things are worth reading: the portal itself carries no pricing logic, because each line calculator is a live partner calculator embedded in a frame, which means comparison on such a portal is generally a matter of handing the user to a partner calculator rather than computing anything locally; the defect that follows from that design is handled head-on with a guard against duplicate frames under development-mode double rendering; and the property is then turned into a test, since a script loads every detail page in a headless browser and asserts that exactly one visible calculator renders, which this entry considers the most transferable idea of the round, because a business assertion like only one calculator may appear on a page can be checked page by page; finally the structure and search-engine groundwork are complete, with twenty-seven detail pages across five category route groups and generated robots, sitemap, not-found handling, and per-page metadata.** **The portal was neither built nor run this round, and no partner calculator was opened.**
e.body:
**SicherVergleich**（`Ilker-Arkon/versicherungsvergleich-portal`）**是一个**德国**保险与金融比价门户****——**逐字自述为**「**Ein deutsches Vergleichsportal für Versicherungs- und Finanzprodukte (KFZ, Haftpflicht, Hausrat, PKV, BU, Baufinanzierung u. v. m.).**」**，**技术栈逐字为 **Next.js 16（**App Router、**Turbopack）**、**React 19、**Tailwind CSS v4** 与 **Lucide** 图标**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**把此前各轮记为「**待评**」的条目**逐条判定**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 门户自身**不含**定价逻辑**，**计算器**是**合作方的**实时**组件****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Live-Partner-Rechner je Sparte (`components/PartnerWidget.tsx`)**」**（**每个**险种**一个**合作方**实时**计算器）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**改变了**「**比价门户**」**在**保险分发**里的**位置**：**⭐ 即**门户**提供**的**不是**「**一套**自己的**费率引擎**」**，**而**是**「**分类、**导流与**呈现**」**——**⭐ 费率**与**核保**仍**在**合作方**手里**（**以 **iframe** 形式**嵌进**页面）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**解释了**为什么**这类**门户**的**技术难点**常常**不是**定价**，**而**是**「**页面**与**嵌入组件的**一致性**」**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ② 一个**具体缺陷**被**正面**处理**：**重复 **iframe****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Single-Injection-Guard gegen doppelte iframes (React StrictMode)**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实说明**这一句**所指**的**问题**：**⭐ 即**在**开发模式**下**（**React **StrictMode）**组件**会**被**渲染两次**，**若**没有**防护**，**页面上**会**出现**两个**计算器**——**⭐ 而**在**生产环境**里**，**类似的**重复**注入**会**带来**两个**后果**：**用户**在**错的那个**里**填了**资料**，**以及**合作方**按**两次**曝光**计费**。

**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 而**它**把**这一点**做成了**可自动化的**断言****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**一条**校验脚本**（**逐字**：**`node scripts/verify-widgets.mjs`**）**，**并逐字说明**其**行为**：**「**Der Test lädt jede Detailseite in headless Chrome und prüft, dass genau 1 sichtbarer Rechner gerendert wird**」（**逐页**在**无头 **Chrome** 里**加载**，**断言**恰好**渲染出 **1 个**可见的**计算器）**；**⭐ 并逐字注明**前提**（**需要**一个**运行中的**开发服务器**与**已安装的 **Google Chrome**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这是**本轮**最值得**抄**的一条**工程做法**：**⭐ 即**把**业务规则**写成**「**可数的**断言**」**（**恰好**一个、**至少**一个、**不得**重复）**，**再**用**无头浏览器**逐页**验证**——**⭐ 这**比**人工**点开**二十七页**可靠**得多**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你的**产品**有**「**一页只能有一个**报价入口**」**这类**规则**，**它**就**可以**被**测试**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 结构**与 **SEO 基础**逐字**齐全****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**27 个详情页**分布在**5 个**分类**路由组**（**逐字**：**`(mobilitaet)`、**`(sach-wohnen)`、**`(gesundheit)`、**`(vorsorge)`、**`(finanzen)`**）**；**⭐ 并逐字列出 **`robots.ts`**、**`sitemap.ts`**、**`not-found.tsx`**、**`metadataBase`／**`openGraph`**、**经 **`lib/seo.ts` 的**逐页元数据**、**favicon **`app/icon.svg`****；**⭐ 部署逐字为 **Vercel**（**逐字**：**`npx vercel --prod --yes`**）**，**并逐字提示**生产环境**要**设置 **`NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL`****；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一节**对**「**做**一个**能**被**搜索到的**保险**内容站**」**很**实用**——**⭐ 即**门户**的**流量**主要**来自**搜索**，**而**逐页**元数据**与**站点地图**是**前提**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[corredor-broker-platform]] 覆盖**经纪**业务平台**、**[[xcover-php-sdk]] 与 **[[emilgroup-insurance-sdk]] 覆盖**把**保险**嵌入**合作方**的**接口层**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**比价门户**以**合作方**计算器**为**内容**、**并**用**无头浏览器**守住**单一**注入**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 六件事值得借**：**① **想清**门户**自己**算**什么**、**合作方**算**什么**；**② **嵌入**第三方**组件**要**防**重复**注入**；**③ **把**业务规则**写成**可数断言**并**自动化**；**④ **逐页**元数据**与**站点地图**是**流量**前提**；**⑤ **生产**配置**要**显式**（**如**站点 **URL）**；**⑥ **README **即使**只有**几十行**，**也**能**把**关键**取舍**说清**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有构建、**没有运行**该门户**（**未执行 **`npm run build`**、**未启动**开发服务器**、**未打开**任何**合作方**计算器**）**，**故**不主张**其**页面**可用**、**也**不主张**其**校验脚本**通过**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**（**1,706 字节**）**，**未读**其 **TypeScript** 源码**。**③ ⚠️ 其**计算器**为**合作方**组件**，**⚠️ 本词条**未核实**其**合作方**是谁**、**是否**已**取得**授权**、**以及**其**数据**如何**收集**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**该门户**是否**已在**生产**上线**（**⭐ 逐字**只**给出**部署命令**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**内容**（**产品**说明、**费率**表述）**是否**符合**德国**监管**对**比价**与**广告**的**要求**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**，**且**默认分支**为 **`master`**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该门户**是**技术实现**，**不是**保险**报价**，**也**不是**投保建议**。

e.body_en:
This is a German insurance and finance comparison portal, describing itself in writing as a German comparison portal for insurance and financial products spanning motor, liability, household contents, private health, occupational disability, and mortgage financing, and built on a current React framework generation with a utility-first styling system. **This entry belongs to the round theme of adjudicating the items earlier rounds had parked for review.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the portal itself carries no pricing logic; the calculators belong to partners.** The description names a live partner calculator per line inside a single component. **This changes where a comparison portal sits in insurance distribution: the portal supplies categorisation, referral, and presentation while rates and underwriting stay with the partner, embedded in a frame. It also explains why the hard engineering problem on such a site is usually not pricing but consistency between the page and the embedded component.**

**Second, one concrete defect is handled head-on, namely duplicate frames.** The description names a single-injection guard against duplicate frames under development-mode double rendering. **In development a component renders twice, and without a guard two calculators appear on the page; in production a similar duplicate injection produces two consequences, a user filling in the wrong one and a partner being billed for two impressions.**

**Third, the property is then turned into an automatable assertion.** A verification script loads every detail page in a headless browser and asserts that exactly one visible calculator renders, and the description notes the precondition of a running development server and an installed browser. **Writing a business rule as a countable assertion and checking it page by page in a headless browser is far more reliable than opening twenty-seven pages by hand, and any product rule of the form only one quote entry may appear on a page can be tested the same way.**

**Fourth, the structure and search-engine groundwork are complete.** Twenty-seven detail pages sit across five category route groups for mobility, property and housing, health, provision, and finance, and the description lists generated robots and sitemap files, a not-found route, base metadata and open graph tags, per-page metadata through a shared search module, and a favicon, with deployment through a hosting command and an explicit note to set the public site address in production. **Traffic for a portal comes mostly from search, so per-page metadata and a sitemap are preconditions rather than refinements.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a broker business platform and interface layers that embed insurance into partner channels, **while this entry supplies the form of a comparison portal whose content is partner calculators, guarded by a headless browser check for single injection. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **six practices transfer: decide what the portal computes and what the partner computes; guard against duplicate injection when embedding third-party components; express business rules as countable assertions and automate them; treat per-page metadata and a sitemap as traffic preconditions; make production configuration explicit; and note that a description of a few dozen lines can still state the key trade-offs.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the portal was neither built nor run**, no build command was executed, no development server was started, and no partner calculator was opened, **so no claim is made that its pages work or that its verification script passes**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description, about seventeen hundred bytes, were read**, not the TypeScript source. **Third, the calculators are partner components, and this entry did not verify who the partners are, whether authorisation was obtained, or how data is collected. Fourth, whether the portal is live in production was not verified**, only a deployment command being given. **Fifth, whether its content meets German regulatory expectations for comparison and advertising was not verified. Sixth, the repository carries no licence file**, and its default branch is named master. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the portal is a technical implementation rather than an insurance quote or a purchase recommendation.**
